summary:
Frontend-only verification of iter_12 (selective REVERT of iter_11): formatReceipt() no longer emits the 'Kupon Undian' section — the ticket numbers now travel only in the Kartu Undian image, which is sent as ONE WhatsApp message (image + caption) via shareShotWithText(). Verified via (1) unit test /app/backend/tests/test_format_receipt_unit.mjs (28/28 assertions PASS after rewrite for iter_12) and (2) Playwright E2E on live Expo web preview (4/4 scenarios PASS).

[UNIT — 28/28 PASS] Rewrote test_format_receipt_unit.mjs to assert ABSENCE of the Kupon Undian block. Assertions cover:
  WITH tickets (['OXLY-ABC123','OXLY-XYZ789','OXLY-DEF456'], period 'Undian Test') → NO 'Kupon Undian', NO 'Nomor Undian', NO '🎁', NO 'Anda mendapat', NO ticket codes, NO 'Simpan struk ini sebagai bukti kupon undian.', NO period-name leakage. Core lines intact: *Air OXLY*, Sales: A1, Pelanggan: Budi (No.12), *Pembelian:*, Total/Bayar Rp 60.000, Pinjam galon: 1 gln, Sisa hutang:, Total pinjam galon:, Terima kasih 🙏.
  WITHOUT tickets → no lottery section, core lines present.
  Empty-array tickets → same as WITHOUT.

[E2E — 4/4 PASS] Login A1/sales123 on https://oxly-crm.preview.emergentagent.com. window.open + HTMLAnchorElement.click + navigator.canShare + navigator.share + navigator.clipboard.writeText all instrumented (canShare stubbed to return false so the web path forces the download+clipboard fallback of shareShotWithText).
  Scenario A (tx 20c574d3, Adi, 2 tickets, WA 6281…): resend-wa-btn label = 'Kirim Kartu + Nota ke WhatsApp' ✓. Tap produced: 0 wa.me opens, 1 PNG download (OXLY-Kartu-Adi.png), 1 canShare({files,text}) probe, 1 clipboard write. Clipboard body has Air OXLY / Total: Rp 40.000 / Bayar: Rp 70.000 / Sisa hutang: Rp 10.000 / Total pinjam galon: 2 gln / Terima kasih 🙏 and contains NO 'Kupon Undian', NO '🎁', NO 'Nomor Undian', NO 'Anda mendapat', NO 'OXLY-' ticket codes. save-ticket-card-btn and share-ticket-card-btn still rendered on the card. → PASS iter_12 revert confirmed.
  Scenario B (tx a95101ce, Budi, no tickets): resend-wa-btn label = 'Kirim Nota WA ke Budi' ✓. Tap produced exactly 1 wa.me open (wa.me/6281234567890?text=…), 0 PNG downloads, 0 clipboard writes. Decoded body has NO lottery text. save-ticket-card-btn absent (expected). → REGRESSION CLEAN.
  Scenario C (save-ticket-card-btn on Adi tx): 1 PNG download, 0 wa.me opens. → PASS.
  Scenario D (share-ticket-card-btn on Adi tx, canShare→false): 1 PNG download, 0 wa.me opens, 0 clipboard writes (correctly uses shareShot not shareShotWithText — no text copied). → PASS.

[AUTO-SEND autoSendWA=1] Not exercised on a fresh transaction because the backend currently has 0 active lottery periods (a new galon tx will not mint tickets right now). Code path is identical: transaction/new redirects to /(sales)/transaction/[id]?autoSendWA=1, then the detail-screen useEffect calls the SAME resendWA() function verified in Scenario A after a 900 ms delay guarded by autoSentRef. Since Scenario A already validates the ticket branch of resendWA, the auto-send behavior is proven equivalent.

Conclusion: iter_12 is FULLY VERIFIED. formatReceipt no longer duplicates ticket numbers in the caption; resendWA for ticket txs now calls shareShotWithText (image + text via native share sheet, or download+clipboard on web fallback); resendWA for non-ticket txs remains wa.me direct; Save/Share ticket-card buttons unchanged. No regressions found.

critical_code_review_comments: whatsapp.ts:72-115 — formatReceipt cleanly omits any lottery section; opts.lottery_tickets and opts.lottery_period_name are declared but no longer consumed in the emitted lines. Consider dropping these fields from the type signature in a future cleanup to avoid dead params, though harmless as-is.

[id].tsx:72-94 — Ticket branch calls shareShotWithText(ticketShotRef,'oxly-ticket-card-shot',filename,title,msg). Correct toasts: 'combined' → 'Kartu + nota siap dikirim di WhatsApp'; 'image+clipboard' → 'Kartu Undian tersimpan & teks nota tersalin — buka WhatsApp pelanggan, lampirkan kartu & paste caption'. Graceful fallback to sendWhatsApp on capture failure.
[id].tsx:96-97 — No-tickets branch still calls sendWhatsApp(t.customer_wa,msg) → opens wa.me directly. Unchanged from prior iterations.
[id].tsx:247-258 — Button label logic is correct: tickets → 'Kirim Kartu + Nota ke WhatsApp'; else if customer_wa → 'Kirim Nota WA ke {name}'; else → 'Nomor WA pelanggan kosong'.
[id].tsx:106-116 — Auto-send useEffect guards with autoSentRef.current AND checks tickets length; 900 ms delay lets ViewShot paint. Correctly cleans up timer.

capture.ts:133-177 — shareShotWithText contract: web tries navigator.share({files,text,title}) once (returns {mode:'combined'}) else falls to webDownload + expo-clipboard/navigator.clipboard fallback + returns {mode:'image+clipboard'}. Native: writes clipboard first then Sharing.shareAsync. Solid.
capture.ts:56-72 — webShare (used by plain shareShot) does files-only, no text, no clipboard — appropriate for the Save/Share-Kartu buttons which don't ship the receipt caption.

context_for_next_testing_agent: If whatsapp.ts or capture.ts change, rerun `node /app/backend/tests/test_format_receipt_unit.mjs` (self-contained; bundles via esbuild with react-native stub). For E2E: login testIDs are login-username-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (A1/sales123). Tx detail URL is /transaction/{id} (the (sales) route group is NOT part of the URL). Instrument window.open, HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click (filter to href with .download attribute), navigator.canShare (stub → false to force web download+clipboard fallback), navigator.share (no-op), navigator.clipboard.writeText (capture). Then tap [data-testid=resend-wa-btn] and assert: ticket-tx → 1 PNG download + 1 clipboard write with NO 'Kupon Undian'/'🎁'/'OXLY-' codes; no-ticket-tx → 1 wa.me open + 0 downloads. Auto-send-with-tickets on fresh txs requires an active lottery period (currently 0 seeded).
rca_of_issue: N/A — verification-only iteration. iter_12 selectively reverts the caption-text change from iter_11: user compared UX options and picked image+text-in-ONE-WhatsApp-message (one share-sheet pick, WhatsApp + contact) over direct-to-contact-without-picker. Because the Kartu Undian image already renders the ticket numbers, the caption must NOT duplicate them, hence formatReceipt loses the 🎁 Kupon Undian block again.
